name: email-triage
description: A short morning debrief of your inbox, sent by iMessage and email at the first free gap in your calendar: what needs a reply, what needs work first, and what's at risk of being missed, linked to your calendar, plus today's events with a note from the latest related email. Keeps a kanban task board in your Google Drive up to date with each debrief. Runs inside Claude with your Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and iMessage connectors on a weekday schedule.
